bio: I study Business, Concentrations in Finance and Data Science, and Computer Science at NYU Stern, graduating May 2027. I'm drawn to the products people spend their free time in (music, video, games) and to the strategy and data that make them grow.

My experience deliberately spans different ways of thinking: future-focused strategy in consulting, financially grounded analysis in models and restructuring, data work that turns messy information into decisions, and consumer-facing product curation, from new flavors to campaigns people actually share. Moving between these lenses keeps me well-rounded, and it's where my best ideas come from: I can look at a problem the way a strategist, an analyst, and a customer would, and find the angle none of them would reach alone.
Off the clock, I perform in dance covers that have reached millions of views, play ten instruments, run large community events, and am always looking for the next great café.
